name: setup
title: Setup
job_to_be_done: Create, align, or update a runnable technical project baseline, including toolchains, adding/removing direct packages, dependency version changes, data infrastructure, commands, CI, ProjectContext, and initial repository delivery. Use for project setup and later foundation changes; exclude product planning, feature implementation, review-only work, application deployment or package/artifact publication, and work owned by a narrower installed platform setup skill.

trigger_surface.description: Create, align, or update a runnable technical project baseline, including toolchains, adding/removing direct packages, dependency version changes, data infrastructure, commands, CI, ProjectContext, and initial repository delivery. Use for project setup and later foundation changes; exclude product planning, feature implementation, review-only work, application deployment or package/artifact publication, and work owned by a narrower installed platform setup skill.
should_trigger: Create a new Node web project, choose the missing stable dependencies, and deliver a runnable baseline.
Align this existing repository: add ProjectContext, CI, declared commands, and a reproducible development baseline without changing product behavior.
Set up this new home website using Harvis as a reference for the technical stack and development workflow only.
Before implementing uploads, add and verify the new image-processing dependency as a separate setup change.
更新这个依赖，并把升级导致的兼容代码一起修好。
Upgrade Next.js and fix every compatibility change caused by that version bump in the same pull request.
should_not_trigger: Plan the product behavior and acceptance criteria for a new sharing feature.
Implement the accepted sharing feature using the repository's existing dependencies and architecture.
Create a new sharing flow using the existing project foundation.
Create the export feature using existing dependencies.
Create a package tracking feature using the existing stack.
Upgrade the billing page layout without changing dependencies.
Review whether we should upgrade the framework, but do not make changes.
Should we add Alamofire? Do not change anything yet.

steps: Resolve create, align, or update mode and the confirmed project/Git delivery inputs.
Select stable compatible technical choices or use a narrower installed platform setup capability.
Generate or update the complete technical baseline without product or business implementation.
Create or align ProjectContext and Agent entry files from verified facts.
Run clean install, declared gates, CI-equivalent checks, and each layer's foundation smoke.
Deliver the reviewed initial baseline or later Setup PR and report versions, evidence, and limits.
decision_points: Whether a narrower installed platform setup capability owns the request.
Whether missing information changes the project form or only a reversible local engineering detail.
Whether an existing destination requires align/update instead of create.
Whether machine-wide, external, paid, secret, publication, deployment, or real-data authority is required.
Whether an update-caused compatibility change preserves existing behavior or needs a product decision.
failure_modes: A document-only shell is reported as a runnable setup.
A reference project's business code, identity, secrets, or data are copied.
A direct dependency change is hidden inside feature implementation.
A version bump omits required compatibility, migration, test, or ProjectContext changes.
An existing project or authored context is overwritten by a generator or newer template.
Initial publication occurs without complete gates and exact-commit independent review.
